dogecoin.text:
Dogecoin pumping again? Elon's at it, shilling memes while Vitalik preaches Layer2 gospel.  
RNDR's AI hype is cute, but SOL's eating your lunch.  
SEC's lurking, ready to ruin the party.  
Crypto's a circus - grab your popcorn.

Yo, Dogecoin pumping cause Elon sneezed again  
SHIB apes screaming HODL like it's 2021  
RNDR simps think AI will save their bags  
Meanwhile SEC's out here playing crypto whack-a-mole  
Web3? More like Web-freeze, wake me when it scales 😴
